## Checklist

- [ ] Works on macOS **and** Windows — or says here which one is untested
- [ ] No file over 200 lines
- [ ] Comments are one line, uppercase, and say *why* (tool docstrings excepted)
- [ ] No fetched fact put into the prompt or the words of a turn
- [ ] Nothing new waits on a confirmation
- [ ] HAPPY.md updated if a file was added, moved or removed
- [ ] Ran it on my own machine
